turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: Yeah, fingers crossed. If not, I'll probably just head home and play some guitar for a bit.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Either way sounds like a great evening. Do you have any new songs you've been working on on the guitar?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Absolutely, music is a wonderful stress reliever. I hope the rest of your shift goes smoothly and you get to enjoy your evening!
